visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) The scene begins outdoors with a young man in a white t-shirt and green bag strap standing near a tree, arms crossed, looking thoughtfully into the camera. He speaks and gestures. (2) A long, orange plastic straw is handed to him from below. The camera pans down to reveal a young woman kneeling on a bench/ground holding a cup of iced milk tea, looking up at him. (3) The man puts the end of the extremely long straw in his mouth and begins to drink. The woman watches him, smiling and talking. (4) The man gestures for the woman to try. She reaches up for the end of the long straw while the man holds it. She struggles to reach it while he laughs. (5) A series of quick cuts shows her finally grabbing the straw and drinking while bubbles and heart graphics appear on screen. They both laugh and appear playful. (6) The video transitions into a stylized montage with neon outlines and fast cuts. They are seen dancing and moving rhythmically in the same outdoor setting. A brief cutaway shows an older woman in a yellow shirt holding a green fan before returning to the main couple dancing.
